notes.title: 1.4.3 Patch!
notes.content:
Hi wastelanders

The recent 1.4.3 patch has fixed a number of reported issues which should make the whole experience much better. 

Specific fixes include...

[*] Fixed armour giving the player radiation.
[*] Displays the correct armour when using the power glove weapon.
[*] Fixed some dialogue issues with the Controller quest.
[*] Fixed some issues moving from different maps - involved the player getting stuck.
[*] Issues with selling equipped items fixed.

Note: older save should work fine but there maybe a few issues with these carried over saves and the 1.4.3 patch.

That's all for now. If any other bugs are found please report them in our 'Bugs' section the Discussions group.

Please drink responsibly.
